items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 June 2026 5:03pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 22 June 2026 at 4:55pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the British Isles.


##Wind##

East or northeast 2 to 4, becoming variable or southeast overnight, occasionally reaching 5 in the east of the area. Becoming variable 3 or less tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Showers in the east of the area soon clearing to become fair, with possible thundery showers for a time overnight in the east of the area. Areas of mist developing tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in any thundery showers overnight, then becoming moderate or good tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling northerly 2 to 4 overnight into Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
